title: Total Laparoscopic Hysterectomy vs Minilap Hysterectomy
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to compare the perioperative outcomes between mini-lap hysterectomy and total laparoscopic hysterectomy (TLH) because of benign indications.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Mobile uterus.
* Uterine size up to 12 weeks gestation.
* Benign lesions.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Enlarged uterus \> 12 weeks gestation.
* Suspected malignancy.
* Large adnexal masses.
